title: Coastal Bluff Walk
text: We hiked beside the ocean and saw seals. Tall cliffs overlooked the salt water. Waves wet the rocks below the trail. Nearby seabirds gathered around the pinnipeds on the beach.

title: Maple River Hike
text: We climbed a woodland trail near an inland stream shaded by maples. A small cascade and a freshwater pool were visible.

title: Almond Nutmeg Cookies
text: Our dessert uses ground almonds, nutmeg, butter and sugar. We mixed the ingredients and baked the cookies in the oven.
